basis: Lam had publicly established the threshold by April 19, 2023. Its fiscal Q4 outlook for the quarter ending June 25 explicitly put consolidated U.S. GAAP revenue at $3.1 billion ± $300 million. The $3.4 billion high end was below $4,403,776,300, or 95% of the prior-year quarter’s $4,635,554,000. The earliest date remains unresolved because the March 7 webcast and the substantive portion of the CFO’s conference Q&A could not be verified.

coverage.detail: January 25 preceding earnings cycle. The $3.8 billion ± $300 million U.S. GAAP revenue guidance applied to the quarter ending March 26. The calendar-year discussion concerned industry equipment spending.

January 25 call transcript. Analysts asked about June and potential trough revenue. CFO Doug Bettinger deferred June guidance to the next earnings call. The analyst figures supply no management upper bound.
February 9 EX-99.1 announced a board appointment.
February 21 EX-99.1 announced executive appointments. Neither February exhibit supplies the CFO’s March conference remarks or June revenue guidance.
Lam named Bettinger as the March 7 speaker, scheduled the public webcast for 10:25 a.m. Pacific, and specified a two-week replay window.
Lam’s March 7 event page confirms the date and time. Its only presentation resource is the webcast link. The page provides no deck or written Q&A.
Following Lam’s exact webcast link returned a cache miss. No audio or transcript was retrieved.
Retrying the event and access key without the optional trailing parameter also returned no accessible content.
The March 2023 Wayback replay lookup was inaccessible. Whether a playable capture exists remains unknown.
The conference host’s March 3 article covers industry themes. The host-site search yielded no Lam session audio, deck or transcript.
The March 7 transcript preview identifies Morgan Stanley’s Joe Moore and Lam’s CFO. Public text ends mid-question at the start of Q&A, before Bettinger’s substantive answer.
A contemporaneous March 7 transcript was identified by its exact article URL. Direct retrieval failed.
BamSEC indexes a revised transcript for the March 7 session between the January 25 and April 19 earnings calls. The public index establishes the record’s identity but does not expose the remarks.
Lam’s March 30 announcement scheduled the April earnings call. The pre-April newsroom review found no separate June-quarter revenue range.
April 19 March-quarter results release. Its Outlook table explicitly names June 25, 2023 and gives a U.S. GAAP revenue range of $2.8 billion to $3.4 billion.
The full April earnings deck independently confirms the $3.1 billion midpoint and $300 million tolerance in the June-quarter U.S. GAAP reconciliation. The revenue adjustment is zero.
Lam lists the May 22 J.P. Morgan, May 31 Bernstein and June 6 BofA conferences after the qualifying April outlook. The prior release and filing review found no intervening preliminary results.
The July 5 notice scheduled the July 26 results call and supplied webcast details without a revenue figure.

July 26 actuals. The same revenue line in Lam’s condensed consolidated statements of operations gives $3,207,257,000 for the three months ended June 25, 2023 and $4,635,554,000 for the three months ended June 26, 2022, a 30.81% decline. Both values are reported directly for the quarter.

publication_date_evidence: Lam’s qualifying release is dated April 19, 2023. EDGAR records acceptance of the 8-K with that release as EX-99.1 on April 19 at 16:14:28. This verifies when the $3.4 billion upper bound was public. The content of the earlier March 7 public session remains unresolved.
